source_interface_filter.application_order: after one approved point-cloud load of both members and exact Nx3/equal-length array validation, before rigid transform, normal canonicalization, identity partition, spatial partition, voxelization, local fit, or any CF-PDG scientific operation
source_interface_filter.original_row_identity: uint64 acquisition-row ordinal 0..N-1 assigned before filtering and carried with every retained row; reports include exact original/retained/rejected identity SHA-256 values and the sorted rejected identity list

source_interface_filter.nonfinite_point: reject when any x/y/z coordinate is not finite
source_interface_filter.nonfinite_normal: after point finiteness, reject when any nx/ny/nz component, the stable hypot(hypot(nx,ny),nz) norm, or the frozen-parent numpy.linalg.norm(axis=1) value is not finite; this guarantees every retained normal is accepted by the byte-frozen parent canonicalizer
source_interface_filter.zero_normal: after point and normal finiteness, reject when stable Euclidean normal norm <=1e-12 inclusive
source_interface_filter.normal_norm_algorithm: zero-threshold classification uses numpy.hypot(numpy.hypot(nx,ny),nz) in float64; parent-compatibility rejection additionally evaluates numpy.linalg.norm(axis=1) under overflow/invalid suppression and rejects nonfinite output
source_interface_filter.retained_order: preserve input acquisition order; no row sorting, duplication, replacement, interpolation, normal estimation, or neighbor borrowing
source_interface_filter.overlapping_predicate_reporting: report the three raw predicate counts plus mutually exclusive precedence counts; exclusive counts sum exactly to rejected_count
source_interface_filter.filter_determinism: same numeric rows and original identities produce byte-identical filtered arrays, reports, and identity vectors; permutation with identities carried is equivariant and scientific partition membership is compared by original identity

source_interface_actionability.invalid_fraction: rejected_count/original_count in binary64; original_count==0 is terminal nonactionable
